confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of South Korean regional pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation. Hotel and hostel rates assume July peak season on non-holiday weeknights and may be understated for weekends or festival dates. The FX figure came from a search summary attributed to the RBA's 15 October 2026 4pm rate; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized South Korean tourist cities such as Jeonju and Andong, adjusted for Gyeongju's heritage-tourism demand. Local won-to-USD conversion assumed at roughly 1,400 KRW per USD.
